title: Sorvete de chocolate
creator: igorochaoficial
statusNote: The method is only shown in the video. The steps are the usual custard-based method.
steps: Whisk the yolks, pour in some hot cream while whisking, then return everything to the pan and stir over low heat until it thickens slightly.
Pour over the chopped chocolate and stir until smooth.
Cool, then freeze, stirring every 30–40 minutes for the first few hours (or churn in an ice-cream maker).
